title: Handroid: Bridging Dexterous Hand and Humanoid
summary: Dexterous hands and humanoid robots are typically developed as distinct embodiments: the former enable contact-rich manipulation at the object scale, whereas the latter provide mobility and whole-body interaction in human-centered environments. We introduce \textbf{Handroid}, a desktop-scale dual-embodiment robot that integrates both capabilities within a single reconfigurable platform. Handroid reuses one 27-DoF electromechanical body as either a dexterous hand or a desktop humanoid, measuring 0.33 m in height and 2.05 kg in weight. In the dexterous hand embodiment, 20 DoFs form an anthropomorphic hand closely matching the kinematic structure of the human hand. In the humanoid embodiment, the same articulated modules are reconfigured into a humanoid with a head, arms, and legs, including a 12-DoF lower-limb structure for locomotion and whole-body motion. Handroid further provides a unified control and learning framework supporting hand teleoperation, dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, humanoid locomotion, gait generation, and interactive motion authoring. We validate the platform through real-world dexterous manipulation, reinforcement-learning-based locomotion, keyframe motion deployment, and a long-horizon task involving embodiment reconfiguration, locomotion, docking, and dexterous pick-and-place. These results position Handroid as a compact and reproducible platform for advancing morphology-reconfigurable robotics and cross-embodiment robot learning.
tldr: Handroid is a desktop-scale dual-embodiment robot that reconfigure a 27-DoF body into either a dexterous hand or a humanoid, enabling both manipulation and locomotion on a single platform.
tldr_zh: Handroid 是一个桌面级双形态机器人，可将 27 自由度机械结构重新配置为灵巧手或人形，实现单一平台上的操作与移动。
summary_zh: 灵巧手与人形机器人通常被设计为两种截然不同的实体形态：前者能在物体尺度上实现富含接触的精细操作，而后者则可在以人为中心的环境中提供移动能力与全身交互功能。本文提出 **Handroid**——一种桌面级双实体机器人，能够在单一可重构平台上集成上述两种能力。Handroid 复用一套拥有 27 个自由度的机电本体，可配置为灵巧手或桌面人形机器人，其高度为 0.33 米，重量为 2.05 千克。在灵巧手形态下，20 个自由度构成拟人化手部，其运动学结构与人类手部高度匹配。在人形机器人形态下，相同的关节模组被重构为具有头部、手臂和腿部的类人结构，其中包括用于行走与全身运动的 12 自由度下肢结构。Handroid 还提供了一个统一控制与学习框架，支持手部遥操作、灵巧抓取、手内操作、人形机器人行走、步态生成及交互式动作编排。我们通过真实环境中的灵巧操作、基于强化学习的行走控制、关键帧动作部署，以及一项涉及实体重构、移动、对接与灵巧抓取放置的长时域任务对平台进行了验证。这些成果使 Handroid 成为推动形态可重构机器人与跨实体机器人学习研究的紧凑型、可复现平台。

title: BayesContact: Uncertain Pose Estimation via Visuo-Tactile Proposals and Simulation-based Inference
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires pose estimates that are often more accurate than what depth-only sensing provides. Existing methods, relying on vision and contact, employ costly offline training procedures that need to be retrained for new environments and geometries. We propose BayesContact, a Simulation-Based Inference framework for visuo-tactile pose estimation in peg-in-hole insertion. BayesContact maintains a particle belief over object pose and fuses depth observations with force/torque-derived contact evidence. We employ simulation based forward models to approximate these observation likelihoods. For each pose hypothesis, a renderer predicts depth measurements and a physics simulator predicts contact outcomes under guarded probing actions; both are scored against real observations to update the belief. The resulting multimodal belief also enables information-gain-based probing for active disambiguation. Across simulated geometries and real-robot experiments, BayesContact improves pose observability and insertion success over vision-only inference by 30%
tldr: BayesContact uses simulation-based inference with visuo-tactile feedback for robot peg-in-hole insertion, improving pose estimation by 30% over vision-only methods.
tldr_zh: BayesContact 通过仿真推理融合视觉与触觉信息，在机器人插销任务中将姿态估计精度提升30%。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作需要比纯深度感知通常提供的更精确的位姿估计。现有方法依赖视觉和接触信息，采用昂贵的离线训练流程，且需针对新环境和几何构型重新训练。我们提出贝叶斯接触（BayesContact）——一种用于轴孔插入任务中视觉-触觉位姿估计的基于模拟推理框架。该框架维持关于物体位姿的粒子置信度，并将深度观测与力/力矩导出的接触证据相融合。我们采用基于模拟的前向模型来近似这些观测似然。对于每个位姿假设，渲染器预测深度测量值，物理模拟器则在受控探测动作下预测接触结果；两者均与真实观测进行评分以更新置信度。由此产生的多模态置信度还能通过基于信息增益的探测实现主动消歧。在模拟几何构型和真实机器人实验中，贝叶斯接触相比纯视觉推理将位姿可观测性与插入成功率提升了30%。

title: Data and Learning Where it Matters for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Learned policies trained end-to-end on large datasets often remain brittle in high-precision tasks and struggle with generalization. We find that these limitations largely stem from a lack of structure and focus in data collection. Our key insight is to leverage dense data collection only for the critical segment of contact-rich tasks and to rely on traditional planning during simple free-space motion. We propose an automated data-collection scheme in combination with offline deep reinforcement learning for the critical segment of the task, eliminating reliance on a teleoperator's skill and on online policy updates. Across four challenging real-world tasks, using only 2 to 2.5 hours of autonomous data collection, we achieve an average success rate of 96%, compared to the strongest baseline at 55%. Notably, performance remains high in out-of-distribution scenarios where end-to-end approaches struggle. Our results pave the way for targeted data collection for contact-rich tasks and for high success rates in precision applications.
tldr: Proposes targeted dense data collection and offline RL for the critical contact-rich segment of manipulation tasks, achieving 96% success with only 2-2.5 hours of autonomous data across four real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出只在操作任务的接触关键段进行密集数据收集并配合离线强化学习，在四个真实任务上仅用2-2.5小时自主数据即达到96%成功率。
summary_zh: 在大规模数据集上进行端到端训练得到的策略，在高精度任务中仍常显脆弱，且泛化能力不足。我们发现，这些局限主要源于数据采集缺乏结构性与针对性。我们的关键见解是：仅在接触密集任务的关键环节采用密集数据采集，而在简单的自由空间运动中依赖传统规划。我们提出一种自动化数据采集方案，结合离线深度强化学习方法，用于任务关键环节，从而消除对遥操作员技能及在线策略更新的依赖。在四项具有挑战性的现实世界任务中，仅利用2至2.5小时的自主数据采集，我们实现了96%的平均成功率，而最强基线仅为55%。值得注意的是，在端到端方法难以应对的分布外场景中，我们的性能依然保持较高水平。本研究成果为接触密集任务的定向数据采集以及精密应用中的高成功率铺平了道路。

title: Orbis 2: A Hierarchical World Model for Driving
summary: Current world models operate at a single level of abstraction, with most prioritizing perceptual fidelity while lacking the spatial reasoning and semantic understanding required for real-world downstream tasks. We present a hierarchical driving world model that factorizes future prediction across two levels operating at distinct temporal and abstraction scales: a high-level predictor that forecasts coarse scene structure over extended temporal horizons, and a low-level generator that produces detailed predictions conditioned on the high-level output. This decomposition yields high perceptual fidelity while also capturing strong spatial and semantic representations. We further show that pretraining with a diffusion forcing objective yields substantially richer internal representations than the standard teacher forcing objective, while teacher forcing -- predicting only the next frame from clean context -- produces more stable autoregressive rollouts. We therefore introduce a generic two-stage training paradigm that pretrains the model with diffusion forcing and fine-tunes with teacher forcing, combining the representational benefits of the former with the rollout stability of the latter. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results across the standard suite of driving world model evaluations on established benchmarks, including long-horizon generation fidelity, steering responsiveness evaluated on counterfactual scenarios, and internal representation quality. Project page with code, demo, checkpoints and qualitative results: https://lmb-freiburg.github.io/orbis2.github.io/
tldr: This paper presents Orbis 2, a hierarchical world model for driving that factorizes future prediction into a high-level semantic/spatial predictor and a low-level detail generator, and introduces a two-stage training paradigm combining diffusion forcing pretraining with teacher forcing fine-tuning to jointly improve representation quality and rollout stability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Orbis 2，一种用于驾驶的分层世界模型，将未来预测分解为高层语义/空间预测器和低层细节生成器，并引入了一种两阶段训练范式，结合扩散强迫预训练与教师强迫微调，同时提升了表征质量和自回归稳定性。
summary_zh: 当前世界模型在单一抽象层级上运行，多数模型优先追求感知保真度，却缺乏实际下游任务所需的空间推理与语义理解能力。我们提出一种层次化驾驶世界模型，将未来预测分解为两个具有不同时间与抽象尺度的层级：高层预测器负责在较长时间跨度上预测粗糙场景结构，低层生成器则基于高层输出生成细节化预测。这种分解既实现了高感知保真度，又捕获了强空间与语义表征。我们进一步证明，相较于标准教师强制目标，采用扩散强制目标进行预训练可产生更丰富的内部表征；而教师强制——仅从干净上下文中预测下一帧——能产生更稳定的自回归推演。因此，我们提出一种通用两阶段训练范式：先用扩散强制预训练模型，再用教师强制微调，从而融合前者在表征能力与后者在推演稳定性上的优势。在既有基准测试的标准驾驶世界模型评估套件中，我们的方法在长时域生成保真度、反事实场景下的转向响应灵敏度以及内部表征质量等指标上均达到最佳水平。项目页面（含代码、演示、检查点及定性结果）：https://lmb-freiburg.github.io/orbis2.github.io/

title: Dynamics-Aware Meta-Imitation for Generalization to Unseen Robotic Manipulation
summary: Imitation Learning aims to learn skills from extensive observations and demonstrations for robots, so it suffers from data scarcity and environment generalization. The existing methods predominantly focus on imitation from in-domain tasks and consequently struggle with generalization to unseen tasks. To bridge this generalization gap, we propose the \textbf{D}ynamics-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{M}eta-\textbf{I}mitation (DAMI) framework. By integrating meta-learning to construct a shared skill space, DAMI equips agents for rapid adaptation to novel tasks. We introduce the Visual-Motor Trajectory (VMT) module to capture complex spatio-temporal dynamics within the task latent space. Furthermore, we propose the Unpaired Unified Task (U2T) block to fuse unstructured multimodal observations. To coordinate these representations, we integrate a Task-Conditioned Feature Modulation (TCFM) mechanism customized for modulating low-level 3D features. By capturing intrinsic dynamics from a random complete reference demonstration, our framework learns the underlying task logic rather than memorizing static cues, ensuring effective generalization. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines regarding direct inference on seen tasks and adaptation to unseen tasks via few-shot fine-tuning.
tldr: Proposes a meta-imitation learning framework with dynamics-aware modules for generalizing robotic manipulation to unseen tasks in both simulation and the real world.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种具有动力学感知模块的元模仿学习框架，用于在仿真和真实环境中泛化到未见过的机器人操作任务。
summary_zh: 模仿学习旨在通过大量观测和示范让机器人学习技能，因此面临数据稀缺和环境泛化问题。现有方法主要集中于领域内任务的模仿学习，难以泛化至未见任务。为弥合这一泛化差距，我们提出了**动力学感知元模仿学习**（DAMI）框架。通过集成元学习构建共享技能空间，DAMI使智能体能够快速适应新任务。我们引入视觉-运动轨迹（VMT）模块，以捕捉任务潜在空间中复杂的时空动态特性。进一步提出非配对统一任务（U2T）模块，用于融合非结构化多模态观测数据。为协调这些表征，我们集成了任务条件特征调制（TCFM）机制，专门用于调控底层三维特征。通过从随机完整参考示范中捕捉内在动力学，本框架学习到的是底层任务逻辑而非记忆静态线索，从而确保有效泛化。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，本方法在已见任务的直接推理和通过少样本微调适应未见任务方面均优于现有最优基准方法。

title: SkillNav: Score-Level Skill Intervention for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents have advanced zero-shot object-goal navigation, yet single-frame reasoning leaves them without the cross-step behavioral awareness an embodied navigator requires, producing recurring failures such as dead-end stalls, in-room loops, and circuitous approaches to detected targets. Prompt-based remedies inflate token budgets across multi-submodule episodes and still struggle to encode inherently spatial signals such as angles, map cells, and viewpoint coordinates. In this paper, we propose SkillNav, an extensible behavioral skill framework for VLM-based navigation that treats the curiosity value map already maintained by modern VLM navigators as a writable substrate on which composable skills inscribe behavioral memory at zero token cost. Skills are stratified into three tiers by their level of behavioral authority, namely soft scaling for proportional reweighting, lower-bound boost for region-level guarantees, and hard override for threshold-triggered forced actions, and cooperate across tiers under a fixed composition order that establishes a predictable, declared priority among skills. This design turns capability improvement into skill registration: new behaviors plug in without retraining the VLM or disturbing existing skills, opening a path for continual refinement. A minimal prompt channel complements the score-level skills with category-level semantic hints, yielding a dual-representation design in which spatial memory lives on the map and semantic memory in short prompts. Training-free, SkillNav establishes new state-of-the-art SPL across MP3D (25.5), HM3D v0.1 (39.3), and HM3D v0.2 (43.2), improving SPL by up to 6.0 absolute over the strongest prior method, and achieves the highest Success Rate on HM3D v0.1 (69.7) and v0.2 (75.9).
tldr: SkillNav introduces a score-level skill framework that writes behavioral memory onto VLM navigators' curiosity value maps at zero token cost, using three tiers of skills (soft scaling, lower-bound boost, hard override) to eliminate dead-end stalls and looping, achieving state-of-the-art SPL on multiple object-goal navigation benchmarks without any training.
tldr_zh: SkillNav 提出了一种分数级技能框架，以零 token 成本将行为记忆写入 VLM 导航器的好奇心价值图中，通过三级技能（软缩放、下限提升、硬覆盖）消除死胡同停顿和循环，在多个目标导航基准上无需训练即达到最先进的 SPL。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）智能体已在零样本目标导向导航任务中取得进展，但单帧推理使其缺乏具身导航器所需的跨步骤行为感知能力，导致反复出现死胡同停滞、室内循环徘徊、以及绕行接近检测目标等故障。基于提示的补救措施会膨胀多子模块任务中的令牌预算，且仍难以编码角度、地图单元、视点坐标等本质上的空间信号。本文提出SkillNav——一个面向VLM导航的可扩展行为技能框架，将现代VLM导航器已维护的好奇心价值地图视为可写入的基底，使可组合技能以零令牌代价在该基底上记录行为记忆。技能按行为权限层级分为三层：用于比例重新加权的软缩放层、用于区域级保障的下界增强层、以及用于阈值触发强制动作的硬覆盖层，并在固定组合顺序下跨层协作，从而在技能间建立可预测且声明的优先级关系。该设计将能力提升转化为技能注册：新行为无需重新训练VLM或干扰现有技能即可接入，为持续优化开辟路径。一个极简提示通道以类别级语义提示补充分数级技能，形成双表征设计——空间记忆驻留于地图，语义记忆存储于简短提示中。无需训练的SkillNav在MP3D（25.5）、HM3D v0.1（39.3）和HM3D v0.2（43.2）上均建立了新的SPL最优水平，较最强先验方法绝对提升达6.0，并在HM3D v0.1（69.7）和v0.2（75.9）上取得最高成功率。

title: AC-VLA: Robust Out-of-Distribution Action Execution via Compositional Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at end-to-end robotic manipulation but struggle with out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization when familiar sub-tasks are recombined in unseen configurations. We identify two mutually reinforcing failure modes: \emph{trajectory overfitting}, where models overfit to holistic trajectory patterns rather than compositional sub-skill semantics; and \emph{perceptual shortcut}, where action tokens over-rely on wrist-view textures at the expense of global spatial grounding. To address both, we introduce \textbf{AC-VLA}, a plug-and-play Action Compositional learning framework comprising two architecture-agnostic components: \textbf{(i)} a compositional learning module that uses an LLM-driven instruction decomposer and a proprioceptive trajectory aligner to generate dense sub-task supervision, followed by mixed training on complete demonstrations and decomposed data to endow the model with compositional generalization; and \textbf{(ii)} a state-conditioned asymmetric masking strategy that suppresses wrist-view inputs during closed-gripper phases, enforcing global semantic grounding. All components are architectural modification-free and directly integrable into any VLA backbone. Instantiated on $π_{0.5}$ and evaluated on LIBERO and LIBERO-OOD benchmarks, AC-VLA achieves a ~28% absolute improvement on compositional OOD tasks while maintaining near-perfect in-distribution performance.
tldr: AC-VLA introduces a plug-and-play compositional learning framework with an LLM-driven instruction decomposer and an asymmetric masking strategy to improve out-of-distribution generalization for VLA models on robotic manipulation, achieving ~28% absolute improvement on OOD benchmarks.
tldr_zh: AC-VLA 提出了一种即插即用的组合学习框架，包含 LLM 驱动的指令分解器和非对称掩码策略，提升了 VLA 模型在机器人操作任务上的分布外泛化能力，在 OOD 基准测试上提高了约 28%。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在端到端机器人操作任务中表现出色，但当熟悉的子任务以未见过的构型重新组合时，会面临分布外（OOD）泛化困难。我们识别出两种相互强化的失败模式：一是\emph{轨迹过拟合}，即模型过度拟合整体轨迹模式而非组合性子技能语义；二是\emph{感知捷径}，即动作标记过度依赖腕部视角纹理而牺牲全局空间定位。为解决这两个问题，我们提出\textbf{AC-VLA}——一种即插即用的动作组合学习框架，包含两个与架构无关的组件：\textbf{(i)}组合学习模块，利用大语言模型驱动的指令分解器与本体感知轨迹对齐器生成密集的子任务监督信号，随后对完整演示与分解数据进行混合训练，使模型具备组合泛化能力；\textbf{(ii)}状态条件非对称掩码策略，在夹爪闭合阶段抑制腕部视角输入，强制建立全局语义定位。所有组件无需修改架构，可直接集成至任意VLA骨干网络。在$π_{0.5}$上实例化，并基于LIBERO与LIBERO-OOD基准评估，AC-VLA在组合型OOD任务上实现了约28%的绝对提升，同时保持近乎完美的分布内性能。

title: RAVEN: Reinforcement-Adaptive Visibility-Graph Planning for Robust Humanoid Navigation with Collision-Free MPC
summary: Humanoid navigation in dynamic environments requires long-horizon planning while respecting short-horizon dynamic and safety constraints. Classical visibility-graph planners combined with model predictive control (MPC) can efficiently generate collision-free trajectories, but their performance depends on manually tuned parameters and accurate system modeling. In real robotic systems, control delays, state-estimation noise, and locomotion uncertainties can cause overshoot and constraint violations even when the nominal path is geometrically optimal. We propose RAVEN, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL)-MPC framework for robust humanoid navigation. Unlike prior approaches that use learning to tune cost weights or replace planning entirely, RAVEN employs RL to adapt the geometric construction of a visibility-graph planner by modifying obstacle inflation and related graph parameters. By directly reshaping the free-space geometry, the learned planner alters the topology of the global path to compensate for delay and tracking imperfections. A collision-free MPC layer then tracks the planned trajectory while explicitly enforcing velocity bounds and obstacle-avoidance constraints. By training under realistic delays and observation noise, RAVEN learns planning adaptations that improve robustness while retaining explicit long-horizon geometric planning and constrained optimization, in contrast to end-to-end learning approaches. We evaluate RAVEN against a manually tuned visibility-graph MPC baseline and a pure RL navigation policy. Results demonstrate reduced overshoot near obstacles, improved robustness in narrow passages, and more reliable navigation under delay and noise. These findings indicate that reinforcement-adaptive graph construction combined with constrained MPC provides an effective and interpretable alternative to end-to-end learning for robust humanoid navigation.
tldr: RAVEN proposes a hierarchical RL-MPC framework for humanoid navigation that adapts visibility-graph planning parameters (obstacle inflation) to improve robustness against delays and noise, then tracks with collision-free MPC.
tldr_zh: RAVEN 提出了一种分层强化学习-模型预测控制框架，通过自适应调整可见图规划中的障碍物膨胀等参数来增强类人机器人导航对延迟和噪声的鲁棒性，并使用无碰撞 MPC 进行轨迹跟踪。
summary_zh: 在动态环境中的人形机器人导航需要兼顾短期动态与安全约束下的长期规划能力。经典的可视图规划器与模型预测控制（MPC）相结合，能够高效生成无碰撞轨迹，但其性能依赖于人工调参和精确的系统建模。在实际机器人系统中，即使名义路径在几何上最优，控制延迟、状态估计噪声以及运动不确定性仍可能导致超调与约束违反。我们提出RAVEN——一种用于鲁棒人形机器人导航的分层强化学习（RL）-MPC框架。与通过学习调整代价权重或完全替代规划的现有方法不同，RAVEN采用强化学习来调整可视图规划器的几何构造，通过修改障碍物膨胀半径及相关图参数实现这一目标。通过直接重塑自由空间几何结构，学习型规划器改变全局路径的拓扑结构以补偿延迟与跟踪缺陷。随后，一个无碰撞MPC层在明确强制执行速度边界与避障约束的同时跟踪规划轨迹。通过在真实延迟与观测噪声条件下训练，RAVEN学会了能提升鲁棒性的规划适应策略，同时保留了显式的长期几何规划与约束优化特性——这与端到端学习方法形成鲜明对比。我们将RAVEN与人工调参的可视图MPC基线及纯强化学习导航策略进行对比评估。结果表明，该方法能减少障碍物附近的超调、提升狭窄通道中的鲁棒性，并在延迟与噪声条件下实现更可靠的导航。这些发现表明，将强化自适应图构建与约束MPC相结合，为鲁棒人形机器人导航提供了一种可解释且有效的端到端学习替代方案。

title: Difference-Based Relational Learning for Zero-Shot Object-Goal Visual Navigation With Direct Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: End-to-end deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for zero-shot object-goal visual navigation remains challenged by the sim-to-real gap, particularly variations in object appearance and restricted camera field-of-view (FoV). This letter proposes a Temporal Difference-Relational Network (T-DRN) for robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. T-DRN combines a Siamese difference-based feature extractor, which computes relational difference between the target and observed objects to produce domain-independent representations, with a dual-frame temporal buffer that preserves short-term object continuity under narrow FoV. Extensive experiments in AI2-THOR demonstrate that T-DRN improves zero-shot generalization in terms of success rates over strong baselines. Furthermore, T-DRN is systematically validated on a physical wheeled robot, demonstrating robust performance under real sensing and actuation constraints and supporting the feasibility of direct sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: Proposes T-DRN, a temporal difference-based relational network for zero-shot object-goal visual navigation, achieving direct sim-to-real transfer on a physical wheeled robot.
tldr_zh: 提出T-DRN，一种基于时序差分的关联网络，用于零样本物体目标视觉导航，在物理轮式机器人上实现了直接的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 端到端深度强化学习（DRL）在零样本目标导向视觉导航中仍面临仿真到现实迁移的挑战，尤其是物体外观变化和受限的相机视野（FoV）。本文提出一种时序差分关系网络（T-DRN），用于实现鲁棒的零样本仿真到现实迁移。T-DRN结合了基于孪生差分的特征提取器（通过计算目标物体与观测物体之间的关系差异生成域无关表征）与双帧时序缓存器（在窄视野下保持短期物体连续性）。在AI2-THOR中的大量实验表明，T-DRN在成功率上的零样本泛化性能优于强基线方法。此外，T-DRN在实体轮式机器人上得到系统验证，证明了其在真实感知与执行约束下的鲁棒性能，并支持直接仿真到现实迁移的可行性。

title: IMBench: A Benchmark for Intuitive Robotic Manipulation
summary: Humans combine reasoning and motor control to solve complex manipulation tasks under diverse constraints. They build an understanding of the physical world that helps them convert reasoning into actions and quickly adapt to new scenes, tasks, and rules. We refer to this capability as intuitive manipulation. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this integration: they evaluate physical reasoning in isolation from execution, or measure policy performance without requiring explicit reasoning. We introduce IMBENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution. Our tasks require models to infer task-relevant physical structure and generate feasible action sequences under explicit constraints, including contact-rich manipulation, tool use, and multi-stage dependencies. We introduce a benchmark of 35 tasks, 14K filtered trajectories, and scalable tools for generating diverse scenarios. Experiments reveal a consistent gap: vision language models show partial physical reasoning ability but fail to produce executable plans, while state-of-the-art vision-language-action models struggle to satisfy task constraints and generalize across scenarios. These results identify intuitive manipulation as a missing axis in current foundation models and generalist robot policies, and position IMBENCH as a step toward evaluating and enabling more integrated, adaptive physical intelligence.
tldr: IMBench is a benchmark that integrates perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution to evaluate intuitive robotic manipulation, revealing a gap between VLM reasoning and VLA policy execution.
tldr_zh: IMBench是一个将感知、物理推理、动作生成和迭代执行相结合的基准，用于评估直觉机器人操作能力，揭示了VLM推理与VLA策略执行之间的差距。
summary_zh: 人类在多样化的约束条件下，将推理与运动控制相结合，以完成复杂的操作任务。他们构建对物理世界的理解，从而将推理转化为行动，并快速适应新场景、新任务和新规则。我们将这种能力称为直觉操作。现有基准未能捕捉到这种整合：它们要么将物理推理与执行割裂进行评估，要么在无需显式推理的情况下衡量策略性能。我们提出IMBENCH基准，旨在将直觉操作作为一项涵盖感知、物理推理、动作生成与迭代执行的整合能力进行评测。我们的任务要求模型推断与任务相关的物理结构，并在显式约束下生成可行的动作序列，这些约束包括密集接触操作、工具使用以及多阶段依赖关系。我们引入了包含35个任务、1.4万条筛选轨迹以及用于生成多样化场景的可扩展工具的基准。实验揭示出一致的差距：视觉语言模型展现出部分物理推理能力，但无法生成可执行计划；而最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型则难以满足任务约束并实现跨场景泛化。这些结果表明，直觉操作是当前基础模型与通用机器人策略中缺失的一个维度，而IMBENCH则作为迈向评估和实现更整合、更自适应的物理智能的一步。

title: Think at 5 Hz, Act at 20 Hz: Asynchronous Fast-Slow Vision-Language-Action Inference for Closed-Loop Driving
summary: Large language models bring instruction following and scene reasoning to end-to-end driving, but their inference latency collides with the control rate a vehicle requires. Existing closed-loop agents hide this gap by invoking the model on alternate simulation ticks and replaying the previous command in between, so half of all control outputs ignore the newest observations. We present a fast-slow architecture that removes this compromise. A frozen 7B vision-language backbone acts as the slow system, digesting navigation instructions and visual history at low frequency while exposing its per-layer key-value cache as a standing representation of the scene. A lightweight action expert acts as the fast system, attending to this cache and to the current camera frame at every simulation tick to regress waypoints in a single forward pass. Since the cache lags behind the world at deployment, we train the expert under randomized staleness, aligning training with asynchronous execution. On LangAuto-Short routes in CARLA, our system produces fresh control at every 50 ms simulation tick and lifts route completion from 37.0 to 94.0 over the frame-skipping baseline. A frame-skip ablation with the same expert separates the two factors at work: the expert raises the driving score on its own, while per-tick freshness raises completion from 82.1 to 94.0 and cuts red-light violations by a third. Trained on a single town, the expert transfers zero-shot to two unseen towns, holding 84-94% route completion where the baseline reaches 31-41%. It reduces open-loop waypoint error by nearly a factor of four compared to the backbone's own action head, at a per-tick model cost of 32 ms that is independent of history length on a single consumer GPU.
tldr: This paper introduces a fast-slow asynchronous architecture for closed-loop driving, where a frozen 7B VLM runs at 5 Hz to provide scene context via key-value caches, while a lightweight action expert runs at 20 Hz to produce fresh waypoints every control tick, achieving large gains in route completion and safety in CARLA.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于闭环驾驶的快慢异步架构：冻结的7B视觉语言模型以5 Hz运行，通过键值缓存提供场景上下文，轻量级动作专家以20 Hz运行，在每个控制节拍产生新的路径点，在CARLA中显著提升了路线完成率和安全性。
summary_zh: 大语言模型为端到端驾驶带来了指令遵循与场景推理能力，但其推理延迟与车辆所需的控制频率存在冲突。现有闭环智能体通过交替仿真时间步长调用模型，并在间隔期间重复使用前一个指令来掩盖这一矛盾——因此半数控制输出忽略了最新观测数据。我们提出了一种快慢架构来消除这一折中方案：冻结的70亿参数视觉-语言骨干网络作为慢系统，以低频处理导航指令和视觉历史信息，同时将其逐层键值缓存作为场景的持续表征暴露出来；轻量级动作专家作为快系统，在每个仿真时间步长中关注该缓存及当前摄像头帧，通过单次前向传播回归路径点。由于部署时缓存滞后于真实世界，我们通过随机化陈旧性训练专家模型，使训练与异步执行对齐。在CARLA的LangAuto-Short路线中，本系统每50毫秒仿真时间步长生成新鲜的控制指令，将路线完成率从37.0%提升至帧跳过基线的94.0%。采用相同专家的帧跳过消融实验分离了两种影响因素：专家模型本身提升了驾驶评分，而逐帧新鲜度将完成率从82.1%推高至94.0%，并将闯红灯违规减少三分之一。仅在单一城镇训练的专家模型可零样本迁移至两个未见城镇，在基线仅达31-41%完成率的场景中保持84-94%的路线完成率。相较于骨干网络自身的动作头，本方案将开环路径点误差降低近四倍，在单张消费级GPU上实现与历史长度无关的每帧32毫秒模型计算成本。

title: NeuroCommitSSM: Decision-Centric Shared Autonomy for Safe Assistive Manipulation via EEG-EMG-ET Commit Readiness
summary: We present NeuroCommitSSM, a decision-centric framework that models when to execute, not just what to do, for safe commit-to-execute control in assistive robotic manipulation. NeuroCommitSSM predicts a continuous commit-readiness score c_t in [0,1] from synchronized electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), and eye-tracking (ET), and converts it into discrete commit events through dwell and hysteresis filtering. A three-state finite-state supervisor, HOLD-ASSIST-COMMIT (HAC), gates execution by requiring both a sustained commit-readiness signal from the neural model and real-time perception and robot-state feasibility, including target visibility, inverse kinematics solvability, and collision-free planning, before initiating motion. We evaluate the framework on N=32 subjects performing five activities of daily living (ADL) tasks aligned with the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF), using leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation and seven sensor-dropout scenarios (S0-S6). NeuroCommitSSM achieves 0.950 action-balanced accuracy with 0.75 false commit events per 1000 REST windows (FP/1k REST), and maintains low false commits and stable state transitions under sensor loss. For example, in the EEG-only condition, it achieves 0.785 balanced accuracy and 0.29 FP/1k REST, whereas the Temporal Convolutional Network baseline produces 99.95 FP/1k REST under the same condition. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation on a Kinova Gen3 arm shows that feasibility-checked execution reduces false starts and decision instability without sacrificing task success. Supplementary materials, including code, datasets, videos, and additional analyses, are available at https://madibabaiasl.github.io/NeuroCommitSSM/.
tldr: NeuroCommitSSM is a decision-centric shared autonomy framework that predicts a continuous commit-readiness signal from EEG, EMG, and eye-tracking to gate safe execution in assistive robotic manipulation, validated on 32 subjects and a real Kinova Gen3 arm.
tldr_zh: NeuroCommitSSM 是一个以决策为中心的共享自主框架，通过脑电图、肌电图和眼动追踪预测连续的执行就绪信号，以确保辅助机器人操作的安全执行，并在32名受试者和真实的 Kinova Gen3 机械臂上得到了验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出NeuroCommitSSM，这是一个以决策为中心、建模何时执行（而非仅决定做什么）的框架，用于辅助机器人操作中的安全提交-执行控制。NeuroCommitSSM从同步的脑电图、肌电图和眼动追踪数据中预测连续的提交准备度评分c_t（取值范围[0,1]），并通过驻留滞后滤波将其转换为离散的提交事件。一个三状态有限状态监督器"保持-辅助-提交"通过要求在启动运动前同时满足来自神经模型的持续提交准备信号以及实时感知与机器人状态可行性（包括目标可见性、逆运动学可解性和无碰撞规划）来门控执行。我们对N=32名受试者进行了框架评估，这些受试者执行与《国际功能、残疾和健康分类》对应的五项日常生活活动任务，采用留一受试者交叉验证和七种传感器缺失场景。NeuroCommitSSM实现了0.950的动作平衡准确率，每1000个REST窗口发生0.75次错误提交事件，并在传感器缺失情况下保持了低错误提交率和稳定的状态转换。例如，在仅使用脑电图的条件下，它达到了0.785的平衡准确率和0.29 FP/1k REST，而时序卷积网络基线在同条件下产生了99.95 FP/1k REST。在Kinova Gen3机械臂上进行的硬件在环验证表明，经过可行性检查的执行在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下减少了误启动和决策不稳定性。补充材料（包括代码、数据集、视频及附加分析）可在 https://madibabaiasl.github.io/NeuroCommitSSM/ 获取。

title: MotionForesight: Re-purposing Video Models for Future 3D Scene-Flow Prediction
summary: Humans can infer how objects are likely to move from passive observation: a cup may be lifted, a drawer may slide, and a lid may rotate shut. Such predictions expose the physical consequences of interaction needed to act in the real world. We study how to learn this anticipation from ordinary monocular videos of human-object interaction. Given a short observed video context, MotionForesight predicts future 3D trajectories for points on the manipulated object. This casts interaction prediction as object-centered 3D motion forecasting without any assumptions on the object properties. Our key insight is that video prediction models already encode rich priors about how objects move during human interactions. We redirect these priors from pixel prediction toward future 3D scene flow. We start from a dense 3D tracker built on a pretrained video model, generate pseudo-ground-truth tracks from complete clips, and train the forecaster using only the observed frames. We replace future RGB and geometry with learned mask latents and train a lightweight adapter to turn the retrospective tracking representation into a forward predictor, while freezing the large video and tracking components. Using just 40k human videos and no auxiliary inputs such as language, MotionForesight generalizes across diverse out-of-distribution objects, environments, viewpoints, and interactions. It also outperforms substantially larger models that use over a million training videos. These results show that we can efficiently re-purpose video priors into explicit geometric forecasts for embodied intelligence. https://motionforesight.github.io/
tldr: MotionForesight repurposes pretrained video prediction models to forecast future 3D scene flow from monocular human-object interaction videos, enabling object-centered 3D motion forecasting without object-specific assumptions.
tldr_zh: MotionForesight 将预训练的视频预测模型重新用于从单目人-物交互视频中预测未来3D场景流，实现了无需对象特定假设的以对象为中心的3D运动预测。
summary_zh: 人类能够通过被动观察推断物体可能的运动方式：杯子可能被提起，抽屉可能被滑动，盖子可能旋转闭合。这类预测揭示了在现实世界中执行交互操作所需的物理后果。我们研究如何从普通的人-物交互单目视频中学习这种预测能力。给定一段简短的观测视频上下文，MotionForesight 可预测被操作物体上各点的未来三维轨迹。该方法将交互预测转化为以物体为中心的三维运动预测，且无需对物体属性作任何假设。我们的核心洞察在于：视频预测模型已编码了人类交互过程中物体运动的丰富先验知识。我们将这些先验知识从像素预测重定向至未来三维场景流。具体而言，基于预训练视频模型构建稠密三维追踪器，从完整视频片段生成伪真值轨迹，并仅利用观测帧训练预测器。我们以学习到的掩码隐变量替代未来RGB图像与几何信息，训练轻量化适配器将回溯性追踪表征转化为前向预测器，同时冻结大型视频与追踪组件。仅需4万段人类视频且无需语言等辅助输入，MotionForesight 即可泛化至多种分布外物体、环境、视角及交互场景，其性能甚至超越使用百万级训练视频的更大规模模型。这些结果表明，我们能够高效地将视频先验重新用于具身智能所需的显式几何预测。https://motionforesight.github.io/

title: Exo2EgoPose: Leveraging Exocentric Demonstrations for Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting
summary: Perceiving multimodal cues and forecasting fine-grained actions from an egocentric (Ego) perspective is vital for applications like robot manipulation. However, previous studies either rely mainly on under-informed visual inputs to predict coarse human motions or follow the VRM/VLA paradigm, which suffers from insufficient robot data and the gap between human and robot embodiments. We observe that 3D hand pose naturally serves as a unified representation to bridge human-robot actions. Hence, we investigate an under-explored Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting (VL-EHPF) task, which aims to predict future Ego 3D hand poses from visual observations, a language instruction, and pose states. To overcome the limited field-of-view and highly dynamic motions in the Ego view, we propose a framework dubbed Exo2EgoPose, which innovatively leverages holistic and stable exocentric (Exo) demonstrations as guidance to compensate for partial and dynamic Ego-view cues. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-level Exocentric Reconstruction Module (DERM), which incorporates the paired Exo videos as supervision to reconstruct their video-level and chunked frame-level representations, thereby modeling spatial contexts and temporal dynamics. Then, the Global-to-Local Modulation Module (GLMM) utilizes the reconstructed hierarchical Exo representations for progressive feature refinement via attention mechanisms and adaptive modulation, enabling comprehensive Exo guidance for accurate Ego hand pose forecasting. Extensive experiments on \textit{AssemblyHands}, \textit{Ego-Exo4D}, and our newly constructed \textit{EgoMe-pose} benchmarks show the superiority of our method, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin. Moreover, it demonstrates an effective human-to-robot transfer capability and yields improvements on the \textit{CALVIN} dataset. Code will be released.
tldr: Exo2EgoPose uses exocentric demonstrations to guide egocentric 3D hand pose forecasting from vision and language, showing improvement on real robot manipulation benchmarks (CALVIN).
tldr_zh: Exo2EgoPose利用外心视角演示来引导自我中心的3D手部姿态预测，在真实机器人操作基准（CALVIN）上取得提升。
summary_zh: 从第一人称视角感知多模态线索并预测细粒度动作，对于机器人操作等应用至关重要。然而，以往的研究要么主要依赖信息不足的视觉输入来预测粗略的人体运动，要么遵循VRM/VLA范式，但该范式存在机器人数据不足以及人与机器人本体差异的问题。我们观察到，3D手部姿态自然可以作为桥接人与机器人动作的统一表征。因此，我们探索了一项尚未充分研究的视觉-语言引导的第一人称3D手部姿态预测（VL-EHPF）任务，旨在根据视觉观测、语言指令和姿态状态预测未来的第一人称3D手部姿态。为了克服第一人称视角视野有限和高度动态运动的问题，我们提出了一个名为Exo2EgoPose的框架，该框架创新性地利用整体且稳定的第三人称演示作为指导，以补偿部分且动态的第一人称视角线索。具体来说，我们引入了双层第三人称重建模块（DERM），该模块将配对的第三人称视频作为监督信号，重建其视频级和分块帧级表征，从而建模空间上下文和时间动态。随后，全局到局部调制模块（GLMM）利用重建的分层第三人称表征，通过注意力机制和自适应调制进行渐进式特征精细化，实现对准确的第一人称手部姿态预测提供全面的第三人称指导。在AssemblyHands、Ego-Exo4D以及我们新构建的EgoMe-pose基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法具有优越性，大幅超越了现有最先进方法。此外，该方法展示了有效的人到机器人迁移能力，并在CALVIN数据集上取得了改进。代码将公开。

title: Embodied Active Learning under Limited Annotation and Navigation Budget for Object Detection
summary: This paper studies how to adapt a computer vision object detector to an unknown environment under both a robot navigation time and annotation budget constraint. Our approach selects informative robot trajectories and image samples to retrain the detector, explicitly targeting its failure cases. Formally, the approach is an embodied variant of batch active learning, where at each round an agent has a limited navigation budget to collect candidate samples and a limited annotation budget for the most relevant images. We leverage spatial consistency to identify images with inconsistent labels, which are likely to provide the greatest improvement to the vision model. We evaluate the approach using different active learning objectives on large scenes from the AI2-THOR simulator and on a real-world setup using a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with the real-time object detector YOLOv5. Through comparison against several baselines, our experimental results show that spatial inconsistency helps guide the agent and select relevant images without external supervision, achieving the highest detection accuracy at the end of the adaptation process under the same budget. The open-source project can be found at https://mkabouri.github.io/embodied-active-learning-od
tldr: This paper proposes an embodied active learning method that selects robot trajectories and images to adapt an object detector under navigation and annotation budgets, using spatial inconsistency to identify informative samples.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种具身主动学习方法，在导航和标注预算约束下选择机器人轨迹和图像来适配目标检测器，利用空间不一致性识别信息丰富的样本。
summary_zh: 本文研究如何在机器人导航时间与标注预算双重约束下，使计算机视觉目标检测器适应未知环境。所提方法通过筛选信息量丰富的机器人轨迹与图像样本对检测器进行再训练，明确针对其失效案例。形式上，该方法属于批量主动学习的具身化变体：在每一轮迭代中，智能体需在有限导航预算内采集候选样本，并在有限标注预算内筛选最相关的图像。我们利用空间一致性来识别标签不一致的图像，此类图像最有可能为视觉模型带来最大改进。基于不同主动学习目标，我们在AI2-THOR模拟器的大型场景中开展评估，并在波士顿动力Spot机器人搭载实时目标检测器YOLOv5的真实场景中完成实验。与多个基线方法的对比结果显示，空间不一致性可在无需外部监督的情况下有效引导智能体选择相关图像，使检测器在同等预算约束下的自适应过程结束时达到最高检测精度。开源项目地址：https://mkabouri.github.io/embodied-active-learning-od

title: Learning Reach-Avoid Task with Reinforcement Learning: Vectorized Simulation and Benchmark
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has a longstanding tradition in addressing the reach-avoid task problem, especially for controlling robotic arms. While this task serves as a baseline environment within the research community, the ability of DRL to effectively learn the each-avoid task in complex and realistic scenarios beyond simplified and restricted tabletop settings remains uncertain. In this paper, we present, for the first time, a comprehensive benchmark for the reachavoid task that accurately captures real-world complexities without simplifications. We demonstrate a diverse range of settings for robotic arm reach-avoid task, which can be used for evaluating DRL research. We achieved this by utilizing the MuJoCo MJX physics engine and parallelizing both the simulation environment and DRL algorithms using the Brax library. We achieved state-of-the-art results with success rates of 96.1% (UR5e) and 98.8% (Franka Emika Robot) for the reach task and 86.8% (UR5e) and 95.2% (Franka) for the static reachavoid task. Our results indicate that while in previous works DRL agents could solve, for example, a reach task in a simplified setting perfectly, their agents performance collapses when evaluated in realistic scenarios. Overall, this work identifies that additional research is still required to claim the successful resolution of the robotic arm reach-avoid task using DRL. The environment and benchmarking code is available as open source at the following link
tldr: This paper introduces a comprehensive MuJoCo MJX/Brax-based benchmark for robotic arm reach-avoid tasks, showing that DRL agents fail in realistic scenarios despite success in simplified ones.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于MuJoCo MJX/Brax的机器人臂避障任务综合基准，表明DRL智能体在真实场景中会失败，尽管在简化场景中表现良好。
summary_zh: 深度强化学习在解决触及-规避任务问题上具有长期传统，尤其是在机械臂控制领域。尽管该任务作为研究社区的基础环境，但深度强化学习在超越简化受限桌面场景的复杂现实情境中能否有效学习触及-规避任务仍不确定。本文首次提出了一个准确反映现实世界复杂性且未经简化的触及-规避任务综合基准。我们展示了机械臂触及-规避任务的多样化设置，可用于评估深度强化学习研究。通过利用MuJoCo MJX物理引擎以及使用Brax库并行化仿真环境与深度强化学习算法，我们实现了当前最优结果：在触及任务中，UR5e成功率为96.1%，Franka Emika机器人成功率为98.8%；在静态触及-规避任务中，UR5e成功率为86.8%，Franka成功率为95.2%。研究结果表明，尽管以往工作中深度强化学习智能体能在简化设置下完美解决例如触及任务，但在现实场景中评估时其性能显著下降。总体而言，本工作表明仍需进一步研究才能声称通过深度强化学习成功解决机械臂触及-规避任务。环境与基准测试代码已开源发布于以下链接。

title: A Task-Space Receding Horizon Controller for Fast Collision Avoidance
summary: Real-time collision avoidance for robotic manipulators requires fast reactions to unexpected obstacle motion and lookahead to avoid becoming trapped by near-future constraints. Full model predictive control can provide this foresight, but its online cost may grow quickly with horizon length, model fidelity, and the number of active geometric constraints. Conversely, horizon-free reactive methods are computationally efficient but can be short-sighted in dynamic clutter. We present a task-space receding-horizon controller that uses a short contact-consistent rollout to generate a terminal kinematic reference satisfying internal non-penetration constraints, then computes only the first input of a smooth minimum-acceleration transition toward that reference. Starting from a closed-loop inverse-kinematics regulation law, the rollout is performed with an iterative dynamics solver operating on inflated convex robot and obstacle geometries, so that robot-obstacle contacts, dynamic obstacle motion, and self-collisions can shape the terminal reference without requiring full constrained trajectory optimization. We analyze the contact-inactive closed loop and show local exponential task-space regulation under standard regularity assumptions. For contacts activated inside the rollout, we characterize the corresponding discrete updates and bound the effect of moving obstacles on regular operating sets. Simulations on a 40-DOF multi-chain system show that intermediate horizons balance anticipation, responsiveness, and computational cost. Hardware experiments on a 6-DOF platform demonstrate consistent sim-to-real behavior without accurate inertial parameter estimation, and comparisons against dynamic optimization fabrics and model predictive control (MPC) baselines show improved success rates in dynamic clutter while preserving solve times compatible with real-time execution in the tested regimes.
tldr: This paper presents a task-space receding horizon controller for robotic manipulators that uses short contact-consistent rollouts to generate terminal kinematic references, achieving fast collision avoidance with computational efficiency comparable to reactive methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种任务空间滚动时域控制器，通过短时接触一致性展开生成终端运动学参考，在实现快速避障的同时保持接近反应式方法的计算效率。
summary_zh: 实时避碰控制需要同时满足对突发障碍物运动的快速响应和前瞻性预测，以避免因短期约束限制导致机械臂陷入困境。全模型预测控制虽能提供这种预见能力，但其在线计算代价会随预测时域长度、模型保真度及有效几何约束数量的增加而急剧增长。相比之下，无时域反应式方法计算高效，但在动态杂乱环境中易出现短视行为。本文提出一种任务空间滚动时域控制器：首先通过短时程接触一致性推演生成满足内部非穿透约束的末端运动学参考，随后仅计算平滑最小加速度过渡过程的首个控制输入。该控制器以闭环逆运动学调节律为基础，采用基于膨胀凸几何模型的迭代动力学求解器执行推演，使机器人-障碍物接触、动态障碍物运动及自碰撞等因素无需完整约束轨迹优化即可塑造末端参考轨迹。我们分析了无接触状态下的闭环系统，证明在标准正则性假设下可实现局部指数级任务空间调节。针对推演过程中激活接触的情况，表征了相应的离散更新特性，并界定了移动障碍物对常规工作集的影响。在40自由度多链系统上的仿真表明，中等长度预测时域能有效平衡前瞻性、响应速度与计算成本。基于6自由度实验平台的硬件测试验证了无需精确惯性参数即可实现仿真到现实的一致性迁移，与动态优化织物及模型预测控制基准方法的对比显示，该方法在动态杂乱场景中成功率显著提升，且求解时间满足测试工况下的实时性要求。

title: A Generative Partially Specified Finite State Machine Approach to Complex Behaviour Planning
summary: Autonomous robots operating in dynamic environments require behaviour planning systems that combine reactivity, interpretability, and adaptability. While Large Language Models have been successfully integrated with Behaviour Trees for dynamic replanning, Finite State Machines, despite their widespread adoption and computational efficiency, remain unexplored for generative approaches. We propose a Generative Partially Specified Finite State Machine (GPSFSM) neurosymbolic architecture that utilises the symbolic and semantic structure of FSMs, including states and event-triggered transitions, to implement Behaviour Planning. This paper introduces the first GPSFSM framework for robotics, featuring Fabric, an FSM engine that parses, validates, and executes behaviour plans that contain Sequential, Recovery, Parallel-Any, and Parallel-All control structures. We extend the Capabilities2 package in ROS2 with an asynchronous event system for behaviour chaining and runtime parameter injection for configurable execution, addressing the ad-hoc function representations that limit current generative systems. PromptTools provides a unified ROS 2 interface to local and cloud LLMs, with prompt buffering, enabling dynamic asynchronous composition of task and context information. Together, these components enable standardised semantic capability descriptions for robot-agnostic development. Experimental evaluation on navigation tasks demonstrates that our GPSFSM approach achieves consistently higher plan-generation success rates than the state-of-the-art BTGenBot system, particularly excelling in zero-shot scenarios where BTs typically struggle, while maintaining comparable or lower planning latency to frontier LLMs. We also demonstrate that our system can generate complex behaviours. We release an open-source ROS2 stack that makes generative FSM planning practical and reproducible for robotic systems.
tldr: This paper introduces a Generative Partially Specified Finite State Machine (GPSFSM) neurosymbolic architecture that combines LLMs with FSM-based planning for autonomous robotic behavior, achieving higher success rates than BTGenBot in navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种生成式部分指定有限状态机（GPSFSM）神经符号架构，将LLM与基于FSM的规划相结合用于自主机器人行为，在导航任务中取得了优于BTGenBot的成功率。
summary_zh: 在动态环境中运行的自主机器人需要同时具备反应性、可解释性与适应性的行为规划系统。尽管大语言模型已成功与行为树结合用于动态重规划，但有限状态机（FSM）虽被广泛采用且计算高效，在生成式方法中仍未得到充分探索。本文提出一种生成式部分指定有限状态机（GPSFSM）神经符号架构，利用FSM（包括状态与事件触发转移）的符号与语义结构来实现行为规划。本文首次提出面向机器人的GPSFSM框架，其中包含Fabric引擎——该FSM引擎可解析、验证并执行包含顺序、恢复、并行任一及并行全部控制结构的行为计划。我们在ROS2的Capabilities2包中扩展了异步事件系统以实现行为链式调用，并引入运行时参数注入支持可配置执行，从而解决了当前生成式系统中临时函数表示的限制问题。PromptTools为本地及云端大语言模型提供统一的ROS2接口，具备提示缓冲功能，可实现任务与上下文信息的动态异步组合。这些组件共同为跨机器人开发提供了标准化的语义能力描述。在导航任务上的实验评估表明，我们的GPSFSM方法在计划生成成功率上始终优于当前最先进的BTGenBot系统，尤其在行为树通常难以处理的零样本场景中表现突出，同时与前沿大语言模型相比保持相当或更低的规划延迟。我们还验证了该系统能生成复杂行为。我们开源了一套ROS2功能包，使生成式FSM规划在机器人系统中既实用又可复现。

title: Continuously Stable Structure through Plastic Deformation
summary: Soft robots have seen widespread adoption in interactive tasks due to their inherent compliance and adaptability. However, these advantages often come at the cost of stability, posing challenges in a dynamic environment. This limitation is especially critical in soft grippers, where instability under acceleration or external disturbances can result in grasp failure. In this study, we present a continuously stable structure through plastic deformation (CSSPD), integrated into a soft gripper. By leveraging the mechanism of plastic deformation, the gripper maintains continuous configurations without energy input, while the added stiffness ensures both static and dynamic stability. We introduce a bioinspired paw pad that significantly enhances stability and enables sensing-based rapid object grasping. Then we develop the mathematical model and optimize the kirigami structure of the metal layer. Experimental results show that the gripper can sustain a passive holding force of up to 16 N without energy input, achieving performance comparable to pneumatic actuation at 0.3 MPa. When combined with pneumatic actuation, it remains stable under pulsed accelerations of up to 400 m/s^2. It can also passively perch on tree branches for extended periods without power, demonstrating promise for mobile robotic applications.
tldr: The paper presents a soft gripper that uses plastic deformation to maintain stable configurations without continuous power, achieving high passive holding forces and stability under acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过塑性变形实现连续稳定结构的软体夹爪，可在无需持续供能的情况下保持稳定构型，实现高被动夹持力和加速度下的稳定性。
summary_zh: 软体机器人因其固有的柔顺性与适应性，已在交互任务中得到广泛应用。然而，这些优势往往以牺牲稳定性为代价，在动态环境中构成挑战。这一局限在软体夹爪中尤为关键——当受到加速度或外界扰动时，失稳会导致抓取失败。本研究提出一种基于塑性变形的连续稳定结构（CSSPD），并将其集成至软体夹爪中。通过利用塑性变形机制，该夹爪无需能量输入即可维持连续构型，同时增加的刚度确保了静态与动态稳定性。我们引入了一种仿生爪垫，显著增强了稳定性，并实现了基于传感的快速物体抓取。随后建立了数学模型，并对金属层剪纸结构进行了优化。实验结果表明：该夹爪无需能量输入即可承受高达16 N的被动保持力，性能可媲美0.3 MPa气压驱动水平；当结合气压驱动时，其在高达400 m/s²的脉冲加速度下仍保持稳定；此外，它还能在无电源条件下长时间被动栖息于树枝上，展现了在移动机器人领域的应用潜力。

title: A Model-Based Decoupling Strategy for Proprioception and Contact Sensing in an Architected Soft Manipulator
summary: Soft continuum robots require embedded sensing for proprioception and contact detection, yet integrating sensors into sparse, highly deformable architected structures remains challenging. We present a model-based strategy that decouples proprioceptive and contact signals from a common set of fluidic pressure sensors embedded in a soft architected segment. Each segment of the Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) contains six air channels routed in a localized zigzag pattern along the circumference. With only three principal kinematic degrees of freedom (axial compression, bending in x, bending in y), the six pressure readings form an overdetermined system. A piecewise constant curvature model maps pressures to shape, and Huber regression identifies outlier channels whose residuals indicate external contact. On a single ITH segment, this approach achieves proprioceptive shape estimation with a relative bending error of 0.11 +/- 0.02 and a contact detection rate of 97% across 178 trials. We integrate eight ITH segments into Air-Helix, a tendon-driven soft continuum manipulator, and present exploratory whole-arm demonstrations that include tactile teaching by demonstration, admittance-controlled force regulation, and tactile object reconstruction. The results suggest that localized fluidic innervation combined with model-based redundancy resolution is a practical path toward concurrent proprioception and contact sensing in architected soft robots.
tldr: This paper presents a model-based decoupling strategy using fluidic pressure sensors and a piecewise constant curvature model to achieve simultaneous proprioception and contact sensing in an architected soft continuum manipulator.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于模型的解耦策略，利用流体压力传感器和分段常曲率模型，在一种结构化软体连续操作臂中同时实现本体感知和接触感知。
summary_zh: 软体连续体机器人需要嵌入式传感以实现本体感知和接触检测，但在稀疏且高度可变形的人造结构内集成传感器仍具挑战性。我们提出了一种基于模型的策略，该策略能够从嵌在软体人造结构段中的一组流体压力传感器中，将本体感知信号和接触信号分离。每个神经化修剪螺旋面（ITH）段包含六个沿圆周呈局部锯齿形路径布设的空气通道。仅凭三个主要运动学自由度（轴向压缩、x向弯曲、y向弯曲），六个压力读数便构成一个超定系统。通过分段恒定曲率模型将压力映射为形状，并采用Huber回归识别残差指向外部接触的异常通道。在单个ITH段上，该方法实现了相对弯曲误差为0.11±0.02的本体感知形状估计，并在178次试验中达到97%的接触检测率。我们将八个ITH段集成为Air-Helix——一种腱驱动软体连续体操作臂，并展示了探索性整臂演示，包括基于示教的触觉教学、导纳控制力调节以及触觉物体重建。结果表明，局部流体神经化与基于模型的冗余度解析相结合，为人造软体机器人实现并发本体感知与接触感知提供了一条实用路径。

title: PACE: Persona Adaptation through Conversational Elicitation in Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Equipping humanoid robots with coherent and adaptable personas is crucial for fostering natural, engaging, and trustworthy human-robot interaction (HRI). However, existing approaches often rely on static, hard-coded identities that lack the flexibility to adapt to individual user contexts. In this paper, we present PACE (Persona Adaptation through Conversational Elicitation), a novel framework for the interactive generation and deployment of structured personas on the Ameca humanoid robot. Our system introduces an Interactive Persona Elicitation Pipeline, enabling the robot to dynamically synthesize a tailored, psychologically grounded identity through user Q&A. This elicitation process feeds into a persona prompt compilation phase, generating a structured persona prompt built upon multi-perspective dimensions. We detail the Embodied System Integration required to translate this structured specification into expressive, multimodal humanoid behaviors. Through a comprehensive empirical HRI evaluation, we assess the impact of dynamically generated personas on user trust, perceived anthropomorphism, persona consistency, personal relevance, and interaction quality compared to a generic baseline. These contributions establish a scalable pathway for deploying personalized, interactive, and reliable identities in embodied humanoid assistants. Video demo is available at: https://lipzh5.github.io/PACE/
tldr: PACE enables a humanoid robot to dynamically generate psychologically grounded, structured personas through conversational Q&A, improving user trust and interaction quality compared to static baselines.
tldr_zh: PACE 让类人机器人通过对话问答动态生成具有心理学基础的、结构化的个性身份，相比静态基线提升了用户信任和交互质量。
summary_zh: 赋予仿人机器人一致且可适应的人格特征，对于促进自然、引人入胜且值得信赖的人机交互至关重要。然而，现有方法通常依赖静态、硬编码的固定身份，缺乏适应个体用户情境的灵活性。本文提出PACE（通过对话引导实现人格适应）这一新型框架，用于在Ameca仿人机器人上交互式生成并部署结构化人格。我们的系统引入交互式人格引导流程，使机器人能够通过用户问答动态合成基于心理学原理的定制化身份。该引导过程随后进入人格提示编译阶段，生成基于多维度视角构建的结构化人格提示。我们详细阐述了将这种结构化规范转化为富有表现力的多模态仿人行为所需的具身系统集成技术。通过全面的人机交互实证评估，与通用基线相比，我们评估了动态生成的人格对用户信任、感知拟人化、人格一致性、个人相关性及交互质量的影响。这些成果为在具身仿人助手中部署个性化、交互式且可靠的身份建立了可扩展的路径。视频演示可见：https://lipzh5.github.io/PACE/

title: VTAP Gripper: Synergizing Fingertip Sensing and a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a tactile-reactive gripper that integrates a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm (VTAP) and compliant, reconfigurable fingers equipped with tactile array sensors. The design exploits structured finger-palm synergy and multi-modal perception to achieve both robust grasping and fine manipulation. The actuated bi-modal palm seamlessly combines long-range visual localization with contact-rich tactile feedback, substantially extending the system's manipulation capability. To bridge the embodiment gap between human hand motion and the heterogeneous three-finger structure, we further propose a staged, gesture-conditioned retargeting framework for dexterous teleoperation. Extensive experiments validate the system across a range of challenging tasks: reactive grasping of YCB and fragile objects, in-hand syringe reorientation and plunger actuation, singulation of clustered objects down to 3 mm in diameter, and vision-tactile peg-in-hole insertion. Results demonstrate that high manipulation performance can be achieved through coordinated finger-palm interaction and multi-modal sensing, without resorting to high degrees of freedom anthropomorphic designs. The VTAP gripper and its retargeting framework offer a practical reference architecture for dexterous gripper design, manipulation, and contact-rich data collection in support of learning-based approaches. Project webpage: https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/.
tldr: This paper presents a tactile-reactive gripper with a visuo-tactile active palm and compliant fingers, enabling robust grasping and fine in-hand manipulation via finger-palm synergy and multimodal sensing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种集成视觉-触觉主动手掌和柔性手指的触觉反应式夹爪，通过指掌协同与多模态感知实现鲁棒抓取与精细手内操作。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种触觉反应型抓取器，集成了视觉-触觉主动掌心（VTAP）与配备触觉阵列传感器的柔性可重构手指。该设计利用结构化手指-掌心协同与多模态感知，实现了稳健抓取与精细操作。可驱动的双模态掌心无缝结合了远程视觉定位与富含接触信息的触觉反馈，显著扩展了系统的操作能力。为弥合人手运动与异构三指结构之间的具身差距，我们进一步提出了一种面向灵巧遥操作的分阶段、手势条件驱动的重定向框架。大量实验验证了该系统在多项挑战性任务中的表现：对YCB物体及易碎物体的反应式抓取、手中注射器重新定向与活塞驱动、直径小至3毫米的簇状物体分离、以及视觉-触觉结合的轴孔插入。结果表明，通过协调手指-掌心交互与多模态感知，可在不依赖高自由度拟人化设计的情况下实现高操作性能。VTAP抓取器及其重定向框架为灵巧抓取器设计、操作及支持基于学习方法所需的接触丰富数据采集，提供了一种实用参考架构。项目网页：https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/。

title: JoyNexus: Service-Oriented Multi-Tenant Post-Training for VLA Models
summary: The post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is essential due to the diversity of simulators, robot embodiments, and task objectives. Existing compute services, whether offered as direct accelerator rental or batch-workload submission, typically allocate an exclusive set of GPU and CPU resources to a single tenant. While this paradigm maximizes client flexibility, it burdens users with infrastructure adaptation, and the fixed card-hour accounting model renders short or bursty workloads both expensive for tenants and inefficient for the service provider. To address these challenges, we present JoyNexus, a unified service for multi-tenant VLA supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. JoyNexus decouples the Training Model Service, Inference Model Service, and Environment Service, each accessed through APIs and backed by resident shared base models with tenant-specific slots. Tenants can directly invoke high-level semantic APIs for training, rollout, and evaluation, or compose custom algorithms using lower-level APIs and their assigned endpoints. Multiple tenants submit workloads concurrently; their action modules, optimizers, rollout records, and policy versions remain isolated, and the service is scheduled by the global Training Queue and Inference Queue. To further improve multi-tenant training efficiency, JoyNexus introduces group batching for heterogeneous VLA data schemas that share a compatible model-facing prefix, enabling a single shared backbone forward pass over grouped samples. Finally, we evaluate JoyNexus through workload simulation and a group-batching pipeline in a realistic embodied scenario. Results show that, compared with isolated single-tenant execution, JoyNexus reduces aggregate GPU time and improves service utilization via cross-tenant scheduling on shared resources.
tldr: JoyNexus introduces a multi-tenant post-training service for VLA models that decouples training, inference, and environment services, and uses group batching for heterogeneous data to improve GPU utilization and reduce costs.
tldr_zh: JoyNexus 提出了一种面向 VLA 模型的多租户后训练服务，通过解耦训练、推理和环境服务，并对异构数据使用分组批处理来提高 GPU 利用率并降低成本。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后训练因模拟器多样性、机器人本体差异及任务目标不同而至关重要。现有的计算服务，无论是直接提供加速器租赁还是批处理工作负载提交，通常会将一组独占的GPU和CPU资源分配给单一租户。这种模式虽能最大化客户灵活性，却给用户带来了基础设施适配的负担，且固定卡时计费模型使得短时或突发性工作负载对租户成本高昂，同时对服务提供商而言效率低下。为解决这些挑战，我们提出JoyNexus——一个面向多租户VLA监督微调、强化学习与评估的统一服务。JoyNexus将训练模型服务、推理模型服务与环境服务解耦，三者均通过API访问，并由驻留的共享基础模型（含租户专属插槽）提供支撑。租户可直接调用高层语义API进行训练、部署与评估，或通过底层API及其分配端点组合自定义算法。多个租户并发提交工作负载时，其动作模块、优化器、部署记录及策略版本保持隔离，服务由全局训练队列与推理队列调度。为进一步提升多租户训练效率，JoyNexus引入了针对异构VLA数据模式的组批处理机制，这些模式共享兼容的模型前缀，从而允许对分组样本执行单一共享骨干网络前向传播。最后，我们通过工作负载仿真及真实具身场景中的组批处理流水线对JoyNexus进行评估。结果表明，与隔离的单租户执行相比，JoyNexus通过跨租户调度共享资源，减少了聚合GPU时间并提升了服务利用率。

title: Vision-Language-Motion Maps: An Open-Vocabulary, Uncertainty-Aware, Queryable Motion Attribute for 3D Scene Maps
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D maps let robots answer language queries about what and where, but they assume a static world and cannot answer queries about how scene elements behave. We introduce Vision-Language-Motion Maps (VLMM), an open-vocabulary, natural-language-queryable 3D map in which each element carries a fused motion attribute: a VLM/LLM semantic movability prior combined with geometrically observed cross-frame motion, together with a per-element uncertainty. Queries reduce to attribute filters that distinguish what has been seen to move, what could move but has not, and what stays still. On a controlled simulator benchmark with exact ground truth (AI2-THOR, three scene types) we show through ablation that the schema fields are non-substitutable: a semantic-only baseline fails motion queries even with strong features, and neither motion field substitutes for the other (the prior cannot answer "what is moving," observed motion cannot answer "what could move"). On real dynamic RGB-D (TUM and Bonn, six sequences) we show the uncertainty channel-our key difference from prior fused-motion work-consistently improves moving-vs-static average precision and reduces false motion flags, and is robust to estimated (noisy) poses. The raw confidence is not calibrated, but post-hoc isotonic calibration reaches an expected calibration error of 0.10. VLMM is a representation contribution: the closest prior maps each lack at least one of the four properties-open-vocabulary, language-queryable, fused prior-and-observed motion, and per-element uncertainty-that our combination provides.
tldr: VLMM extends open-vocabulary 3D scene maps with a fused motion attribute combining VLM/LLM semantic movability priors and observed cross-frame motion, plus per-element uncertainty, enabling natural-language queries about motion.
tldr_zh: VLMM 在开放词汇的3D场景地图中融合了 VLM/LLM 语义可动性先验与跨帧观测运动，并引入逐元素不确定性，从而支持关于运动的自然语言查询。
summary_zh: 开放词汇三维地图使机器人能够回答关于“是什么”和“在哪里”的语言查询，但这类地图假设世界是静态的，无法回答关于场景元素如何运动的问题。我们提出视觉-语言-运动地图（VLMM），这是一种开放词汇、支持自然语言查询的三维地图，其中每个元素都携带一个融合的运动属性：即由VLM/LLM生成的语义可运动性先验，结合通过几何方法观测到的跨帧运动，以及每个元素对应的不确定性。查询可简化为属性过滤器，用于区分已观察到运动的物体、可能运动但尚未运动的物体，以及保持静止的物体。在具有精确真实标注的受控模拟器基准测试中（AI2-THOR，三种场景类型），我们通过消融实验证明各模态字段不可替代：仅使用语义信息的基线即便具有强特征也无法完成运动查询，且两种运动场彼此不可替代（先验无法回答“什么正在运动”，观测运动无法回答“什么可能运动”）。在真实动态RGB-D数据上（TUM和Bonn数据集，共六个序列），我们展示了不确定性通道——这是我们与先前融合运动工作的关键区别——能够持续提升运动与静态目标的平均精度，减少虚假运动标记，并且对估计的（含噪声）位姿具有鲁棒性。原始置信度未经校准，但事后等渗校准可达到0.10的期望校准误差。VLMM是一项表征层面的贡献：最接近的现有地图各自至少缺少我们组合所提供的四个属性之一——开放词汇、可语言查询、融合先验与观测运动、以及每个元素的不确定性。

title: VTLoc: Learning-based Tactile Contact Localization in Visual Point Clouds
summary: Vision and touch are complementary modalities essential for robotic perception and manipulation. While vision provides global object context, touch offers precise local information at contact points. Integrating these modalities for contact localization, i.e., predicting the location of touch on an object's surface, poses significant challenges due to the need for accurate spatial alignment between tactile data and visual geometry. To address this challenge, we propose VTLoc, a novel visual-tactile framework that localizes contact points from tactile readings using a 3D point cloud as visual input. VTLoc introduces two key components: a geometric multi-modal alignment module, which reconstructs a pseudo-point cloud from fused visual-tactile features and aligns it with the visual point cloud to enforce spatial consistencies across modalities; and an iterative localizing updater, which iteratively refines the predicted contact location using fused visual-tactile features. Evaluated on a new benchmark of 100 real-world objects, VTLoc improves single-touch contact localization by reducing local-to-global correspondence ambiguity.
tldr: VTLoc proposes a visual-tactile framework that uses a pseudo-point cloud reconstruction and iterative refinement to localize tactile contact points within a visual 3D point cloud, reducing correspondence ambiguity.
tldr_zh: VTLoc提出了一种视觉-触觉框架，通过伪点云重建和迭代优化，在视觉3D点云中定位触觉接触点，减少对应模糊性。
summary_zh:
摘要：
视觉与触觉是机器人感知与操作中相辅相成的两种模态。视觉可提供物体的全局语境信息，而触觉则能获取接触点处精确的局部细节。将这两种模态融合以实现接触定位（即预测触摸在物体表面的位置）面临显著挑战，主要源于触觉数据与视觉几何之间精确空间对齐的需求。为此，我们提出VTLoc——一种新颖的视觉-触觉框架，通过将三维点云作为视觉输入，从触觉读数中定位接触点。VTLoc包含两个核心组件：几何多模态对齐模块，该模块从融合的视觉-触觉特征中重建伪点云，并将其与视觉点云对齐以强制模态间的空间一致性；以及迭代定位更新器，利用融合的视觉-触觉特征迭代优化预测的接触位置。在包含100个真实物体的新基准测试中，VTLoc通过降低局部与全局对应关系的模糊性，提升了单点触接触定位的准确性。

title: Let the Body Follow: Coupled Egocentric Control for Whole-Body Robot Teleoperation
summary: Whole-body teleoperation requires users to coordinate perception, manipulation, posture, and mobility across multiple robot components. This coordination is difficult because users must simultaneously control the robot's head, arms, torso, and base while maintaining task awareness and avoiding kinematic or environmental constraints. In this paper, we propose coupled egocentric control, a body-following teleoperation approach in which the robot's torso and base automatically respond to the operator's head and arm motions. Rather than requiring explicit touchpad commands for every torso or base adjustment, the system lets users focus on gaze and hand control: head pitch adjusts torso height, head yaw drives base rotation, end-effector height adjusts torso motion, and end-effector workspace boundaries trigger base translation. We evaluate this approach in a user study on whole-body teleoperation of a TIAGo mobile manipulator for home-care-inspired tasks. Compared with a baseline hybrid interface, coupled egocentric control improves object manipulation efficiency, reduces button-based control effort and arm singularities, lowers mental demand and overall workload, and increases ease of use, ease of learning, confidence, and user preference for torso and base control.
tldr: This paper introduces coupled egocentric control for whole-body teleoperation, where the robot's torso and base automatically follow the operator's head and arm motions, reducing manual control burden and improving efficiency in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出耦合的自我中心控制用于全身远程操作，使机器人的躯干和底座自动跟随操作者的头部和手臂运动，减少手动控制负担并提高操作效率。
summary_zh: 全身遥操作要求用户协调多个机器人组件的感知、操作、姿态与移动能力。这种协调十分困难，因为用户必须同时控制机器人的头部、手臂、躯干与基座，同时保持任务感知并避免运动学或环境约束。本文提出了一种耦合的自我中心控制方法，这是一种躯体跟随式遥操作方案，其中机器人的躯干和基座自动响应操作者的头部和手臂运动。该系统无需用户为每次躯干或基座调整发出显式的触摸板指令，而是让用户专注于视线与手部控制：头部俯仰调节躯干高度，头部偏航驱动基座旋转，末端执行器高度调节躯干运动，而末端执行器工作空间边界则触发基座平移。我们通过一项针对TIAGo移动操作平台的家庭护理任务全身遥操作的用户研究评估了该方法。与基线混合界面相比，耦合的自我中心控制提升了物体操作效率，减少了基于按钮的控制操作与手臂奇异性，降低了认知需求与整体工作负荷，同时提高了易用性、易学性、操作信心，并增强了用户对躯干和基座控制的偏好。

title: PIXIE: A Zero-Shot texture-invariant 6D pose estimation framework for unseen objects with assembly defects
summary: 6D pose estimation remains a key challenge in robotics and computer vision, particularly in industrial environments. The deployment of currently available data-driven methods is often limited by resource-intensive data pipelines, reliance on textured 3D models, and sensitivity to geometric deviations caused by damages or assembly defects. We present PIXIE, a zero-shot framework that estimates the 6D pose of an object from an RGB image using only an untextured 3D model. Synthetic depth and normal maps are rendered from sampled reference viewpoints and matched to the query image via a pretrained cross-modality feature matcher. Matched keypoints are back-projected to obtain 2D--3D correspondences for PnP-based pose estimation. Relying exclusively on geometry makes the method inherently robust to lighting and texture variation, while correspondence filtering handles geometric deviations between the model and physical object. We evaluate on widely-used public benchmarks, reporting state-of-the-art results on texture-less objects without object-specific training, and introduce a novel dataset with assembly defects, texture variations, and occlusion to demonstrate real-world applicability.
tldr: PIXIE is a zero-shot 6D pose estimation framework that uses only an untextured 3D model and a pretrained cross-modality feature matcher to estimate object pose from a single RGB image, demonstrating robustness to texture variation and geometric defects in industrial settings.
tldr_zh: PIXIE 是一个零样本的6D姿态估计框架，仅使用无纹理的3D模型和预训练的跨模态特征匹配器，从单张RGB图像中估计物体姿态，对纹理变化和几何缺陷具有鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 6D姿态估计仍是机器人技术与计算机视觉领域的关键挑战，尤其在工业环境中。当前数据驱动方法的部署通常受限于资源密集型数据处理流程、对带纹理3D模型的依赖，以及对损伤或装配缺陷导致的几何偏差的敏感性。我们提出PIXIE——一种零样本框架，仅使用无纹理3D模型即可从RGB图像中估计物体的6D姿态。通过从采样参考视点渲染合成深度图与法线图，并利用预训练的跨模态特征匹配器与查询图像进行匹配。将匹配的关键点反向投影以获得2D-3D对应关系，进而基于PnP方法实现姿态估计。该方法完全依赖几何信息，因此对光照和纹理变化具有内在鲁棒性，同时通过对应点滤波处理模型与实物间的几何偏差。我们在广泛使用的公开基准上进行评估，报告了无需针对特定物体训练即可在无纹理物体上取得的最优结果，并引入了一个包含装配缺陷、纹理变化和遮挡的新数据集以证明其实用性。

title: Beyond Frontiers: Scene-Anomaly Guided Autonomous Exploration
summary: Autonomous exploration of unknown 3D environments is traditionally driven by coverage-maximizing geometric heuristics. However, these methods typically determine exploration targets without considering the underlying structural context. This leads to inefficient trajectories often limiting the fidelity of the final 3D reconstruction. To bridge the gap between spatial coverage and reconstruction quality, we introduce a novel paradigm: reframing exploration as a geometric anomaly minimization problem. We present SCAGE: SCene Anomaly Guided Exploration, a novel autonomous exploration framework that operates directly on unstructured 3D point clouds. Instead of blindly chasing volumetric boundaries, we equip the robot with a foundational understanding of standard indoor architecture. As the robot navigates, it continuously evaluates its live 3D observations against these learned expectations. When the incoming geometry contradicts the learned priors of a typical indoor environment, such as a fragmented wall or a partial table, the system flags these regions as scene anomalies. These geometric inconsistencies act as a guiding signal, naturally drawing the robot to investigate and resolve these structural anomalies from optimal vantage points. By actively targeting poorly reconstructed regions rather than just empty space, our approach seamlessly couples spatial discovery with high-fidelity mapping. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SCAGE achieves superior volumetric coverage (~90% in all scenes) and higher 3D reconstruction quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes SCAGE, a novel autonomous exploration framework that reframes 3D exploration as a geometric anomaly minimization problem, using learned priors of indoor architecture to guide a robot toward poorly reconstructed regions, achieving superior coverage and reconstruction quality.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SCAGE，一种新型自主探索框架，将3D探索重新定义为几何异常最小化问题，利用室内建筑结构的先验知识引导机器人前往重建不佳的区域，从而获得更优的覆盖率和重建质量。
summary_zh: 未知三维环境的自主探索传统上由最大化覆盖率的几何启发式方法驱动。然而，这些方法通常在确定探索目标时不考虑底层结构上下文，导致生成低效的轨迹，常常限制最终三维重建的精度。为弥合空间覆盖与重建质量之间的差距，我们提出一种新范式：将探索重新定义为几何异常最小化问题。我们提出SCAGE（场景异常引导探索），这是一种直接操作于非结构化三维点云的新型自主探索框架。不同于盲目追逐体积边界，我们赋予机器人对标准室内建筑的基础理解。当机器人导航时，它会持续根据这些学习到的预期评估其实时三维观测数据。当输入几何结构偏离典型室内环境的先验知识（如碎片化的墙壁或不完整的桌面）时，系统将这些区域标记为场景异常。这些几何不一致性作为引导信号，自然驱使机器人从最优观测角度调查并解析这些结构异常。通过主动针对重建不佳的区域（而非仅针对空白空间），我们的方法将空间探索与高保真建图无缝结合。大量评估表明，与现有最先进基线方法相比，SCAGE实现了更优的体积覆盖率（所有场景中约90%）及更高的三维重建质量。

title: Implicit Virtual Leader: Decentralized Vision-Only Relative Pose Estimation for Multi-Robot Formations
summary: Classical leader-follower formation control suffers from single points of failure and error propagation, and relies on absolute localization sensors that are ill-suited for GPS-denied environments. We address these limitations by introducing a fully decentralized, vision-only relative pose estimation framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The key idea is the implicit virtual leader (IVL): a non-physical formation reference frame that is not tied to any individual robot but is implicitly learned within the GNN using only monocular images and inter-robot communication. We attach a heteroscedastic GNLL head for aleatoric uncertainty and MC~Dropout for epistemic uncertainty, and conduct a systematic comparison across simulation and real-world test sets. Our framework achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy and generalizes naturally to heterogeneous robot platforms and varying formation sizes.
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized, vision-only relative pose estimation framework for multi-robot formations using Graph Neural Networks with an implicit virtual leader, achieving competitive accuracy and generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络的去中心化、仅视觉的相对位姿估计框架，通过隐式虚拟领航者实现多机器人编队，在精度和泛化性上表现优异。
summary_zh: 经典领航-跟随编队控制存在单点故障与误差传播问题，且依赖不适用于GPS拒止环境的绝对定位传感器。我们通过引入一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的全分布式、纯视觉相对位姿估计框架来解决这些局限性。其核心思想是隐式虚拟领航者（IVL）：一个非物理编队参考坐标系，不绑定任何具体机器人，而是仅利用单目图像和机器人间通信在GNN中隐式学习得到。我们附加了用于偶然不确定性的异方差GNLL头部模块和用于认知不确定性的MC Dropout模块，并在仿真与真实世界测试集上进行了系统对比。该框架实现了具有竞争力的位姿估计精度，并能自然地泛化至异构机器人平台及不同编队规模。

title: Learning a System-Level Surrogate for Hydraulic Excavators: A Simulation-to-Real LSTM Approach
summary: Developing autonomous hydraulic excavators is constrained by limited access to physical machines and the high cost of real-world experimentation. This paper proposes a simulation-to-real framework for learning a system-level digital surrogate using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Instead of modeling internal dynamics, the excavator is treated as an input-output operator, and the surrogate is trained to reproduce its closed-loop behavior under identical control inputs. The approach is first validated in a MuJoCo simulation environment and then transferred to a real excavator. To address measurement inconsistencies in real-world data, a consistency-aware state estimation method based on adaptive Kalman filtering is introduced. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned surrogate achieves high fidelity in both angular velocity and long-horizon trajectory reproduction under closed-loop autoregressive evaluation. These results confirm that the proposed model can serve as a drop-in surrogate for both simulation and physical systems, enabling scalable and efficient development of excavation automation algorithms.
tldr: This paper presents a simulation-to-real LSTM-based surrogate model for hydraulic excavators, treating the system as an input-output operator and using adaptive Kalman filtering for consistency-aware state estimation, demonstrating high-fidelity closed-loop trajectory reproduction on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LSTM的液压挖掘机系统级替代模型，采用仿真到真实迁移方法，将系统视为输入-输出算子，并利用自适应卡尔曼滤波实现一致性感知状态估计，在真实硬件上实现了高保真闭环轨迹复现。
summary_zh: 开发自主液压挖掘机受限于实体设备获取困难及真实环境实验成本高昂。本文提出一种基于长短期记忆网络学习系统级数字替代模型的仿真-现实迁移框架。该方法不建立内部动力学模型，而是将挖掘机视为输入-输出算子，训练替代模型在相同控制输入下复现其闭环行为。首先在MuJoCo仿真环境中验证该方法的有效性，随后将其迁移至真实挖掘机。针对真实数据中的测量不一致性，提出基于自适应卡尔曼滤波的一致性感知状态估计方法。实验结果表明，在闭环自回归评估模式下，所学替代模型在角速度和长时域轨迹复现方面均达到高保真度。该结果证实所提模型可作为仿真与物理系统的直接替代方案，实现挖掘自动化算法的可扩展高效开发。

title: ImprovedVBGS: Real-time Continual Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting
summary: On-the-fly reconstruction is a key requirement for many applications in robotics and autonomous navigation. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) enables continual learning without replay buffers using Coordinate Ascent Variational Inference (CAVI), but its per-frame iterations over all observed points make it too slow for real-time use with strict memory and latency requirements. We present ImprovedVBGS, an accelerated framework for on-the-fly continual reconstruction. This is achieved primarily through (i) spatially truncated variational inference, and (ii) improved reassignment that uses forwarding, truncation and eliminates wasteful dynamic recompilation. On the NeRF synthetic dataset, we reduce mean per-frame latency from ~84.0 s to ~0.050 s on an RTX 3070 Ti, a 1680x speed-up while maintaining reconstruction quality.
tldr: ImprovedVBGS speeds up real-time continual Gaussian splatting reconstruction by 1680x via spatially truncated variational inference and improved reassignment, targeting robotics and autonomous navigation applications.
tldr_zh: ImprovedVBGS 通过空间截断变分推断和改进的重新分配方法，将实时连续高斯溅射重建速度提升 1680 倍，适用于机器人和自主导航。
summary_zh: 即时重建是机器人技术与自主导航中众多应用的关键需求。变分贝叶斯高斯泼溅（VBGS）通过坐标上升变分推断（CAVI）实现了无需回放缓冲区的持续学习，但其对每帧所有观测点进行迭代的方式，使其在苛刻的内存与延迟要求下难以满足实时应用。我们提出ImprovedVBGS，一种用于即时持续重建的加速框架。该加速主要通过以下两点实现：(i) 空间截断变分推断，以及(ii) 改进的重分配策略——该策略采用前向传播、截断操作并消除无效的动态重编译。在NeRF合成数据集上，我们在RTX 3070 Ti上将平均每帧延迟从约84.0秒降低至约0.050秒，实现了1680倍加速，同时保持了重建质量。

title: Vision-Language Assistant for Emotional Reactions to Risky Driving
summary: This study introduces a vision-language pipeline that detects risky driving behaviors and generates emotionally expressive responses to support driver awareness and comfort. Although vision-language models have advanced perception and reasoning in autonomous driving, existing systems rarely consider the emotional dimension or real-world user experience. Keep Yelling Assistant (KYA) detects high-risk driving maneuvers in real time, such as sudden cut-ins. It then produces emotional responses through a large language model tailored to driver preferences. The framework comprises two core modules. The vision module uses YOLOv8 variants to detect nearby vehicles and identify risky behaviors such as sudden cut-ins. Key driving metrics, including relative distance, speed, and projected reach time, are extracted and normalized to produce a structured behavior log. The language module processes this log with user-defined emotional tone settings, such as neutral, humorous, and analytical, and generates verbal reactions using state-of-the-art large language models, including ChatGPT-4o, Claude 3, Gemini 2.5, and Copilot. We evaluated the proposed system using dashcam videos containing risky driving behaviors and a user study involving 108 participants. Participants selected preferred response styles, and the large language models were evaluated based on emotional alignment. All models received favorable ratings, although preferences varied across personas. Notably, the combination of YOLOv8s and ChatGPT-4o achieved the highest score of 4.29 out of 5.00. By integrating real-world perception with emotionally adaptive dialogue, KYA introduces a new paradigm for emotionally intelligent in-vehicle artificial intelligence. It offers promising directions for improving safety, trust, and emotional well-being in both conventional and autonomous vehicles.
tldr: KYA is a vision-language pipeline that detects risky driving behaviors and generates emotionally expressive verbal reactions using YOLOv8 and LLMs, evaluated with dashcam videos and a user study.
tldr_zh: KYA 是一个视觉-语言管道，能够检测危险驾驶行为并通过 YOLOv8 和大语言模型生成带有情感表达的语言反应，通过车载视频和用户研究进行了评估。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种视觉-语言处理流程，能够检测危险驾驶行为并生成情感化表达反馈，以增强驾驶员感知与舒适度。尽管视觉-语言模型在自动驾驶的感知与推理领域已取得进展，但现有系统极少考虑情感维度或真实用户体验。"保持警觉助手"（KYA）可实时检测高风险驾驶操作（如突然切入），并通过适配驾驶员偏好的大型语言模型生成情感响应。该框架包含两大核心模块：视觉模块采用YOLOv8变体检测周边车辆并识别突然切入等危险行为，同时提取并标准化相对距离、速度、预计到达时间等关键驾驶指标，生成结构化行为日志；语言模块则结合用户定义的情感基调（如中性、幽默、分析型），利用ChatGPT-4o、Claude 3、Gemini 2.5及Copilot等前沿大型语言模型生成语言反馈。我们采用包含危险驾驶行为的行车记录仪视频及108名参与者的用户研究进行系统评估。参与者选择偏好的响应风格后，基于情感一致性对大型语言模型进行评价。尽管不同角色类型的偏好存在差异，所有模型均获好评。其中，YOLOv8s与ChatGPT-4o的组合取得4.29分（满分5.00）的最高评分。通过将现实世界感知与情感自适应对话相结合，KYA为车载人工智能的情感智能范式开辟了新方向，为传统车辆与自动驾驶车辆在提升安全性、信任度及情感福祉方面提供了具有前景的发展路径。

title: DPNeXt: A Lightweight Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Framework for Efficient ViT-Based Multi-Task Dense Prediction
summary: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) in robotics perception systems supports comprehensive 3D spatial scene understanding by integrating semantic segmentation and depth estimation. While Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) are increasingly adopted as robust feature encoders, existing decoding strategies present a critical bottleneck. To address this, we propose DPNeXt, a streamlined multi-scale feature fusion decoder and efficient alternative to the standard Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT). DPNeXt uses dual depthwise separable inverted bottlenecks to improve frozen VFM utilization through fusion-centric decoding and independent task modularization. To further mitigate negative inductive transfer between tasks, we introduce the Multi-Task Boundary Guidance (MTBG) strategy. Unlike prior boundary-aware methods that add fusion modules or gating, MTBG applies symmetric boundary-focused supervision to encourage geometric consistency without extra annotation or inference cost. Experiments on Cityscapes show that DPNeXt-S outperforms prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) MTL models, while DPNeXt-B further improves the overall performance and achieves the best results among the compared methods. On NYUv2, DPNeXt-B also achieves the best semantic segmentation and depth estimation results among the compared methods while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters than prior large-scale MTL models. Compared with the standard DPT, DPNeXt-S reduces trainable parameters by 78.6% and achieves the fastest inference speed among the compared models on resource-constrained laptop hardware. The source code, model checkpoints, and a demo video will be made available at https://github.com/kangjehun/DPNeXt.
tldr: DPNeXt proposes a lightweight multi-scale feature fusion decoder for ViT-based multi-task dense prediction, reducing parameters by 78.6% versus standard DPT while improving semantic segmentation and depth estimation on Cityscapes and NYUv2.
tldr_zh: DPNeXt提出了一种轻量级的多尺度特征融合解码器，用于基于ViT的多任务密集预测，相比标准DPT减少了78.6%的参数，同时在Cityscapes和NYUv2上提升了语义分割和深度估计性能。

title: Deployment-Ready UWB Localization for Industrial Ground Robots with Automatic Anchor Calibration and Terrain-Aware Fusion
summary: Ultra-Wideband (UWB) ranging has become a viable option for industrial Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) localization due to improved accuracy and low cost. However, real-world deployments remain limited by two recurring challenges: calibrating static anchors can be time-consuming and error-prone, and integrating UWB with existing onboard sensors requires careful design to ensure robust and consistent pose estimation. Addressing these challenges, this paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that combines automatic anchor calibration with a generic multi-sensor estimator tailored to surface-bound vehicle motion. It targets existing AMR stacks in scenarios where robot pose priors are available for initialization. The calibration stage estimates anchor positions and range biases, while the localization stage fuses UWB with proprioceptive sensing in a bias-aware Extended Kalman Filter to improve consistency without extensive parameter tuning. Experiments on a commercial logistics AMR in a warehouse setting demonstrate accurate positioning indoors and across outdoor transitions, with improved consistency compared to an earlier estimator formulation. Evaluation on an independent forklift dataset further indicates transferability to other platforms. The method remains effective in test cases with limited line-of-sight and sparse anchor coverage. These results show that UWB localization can be deployed with substantially reduced manual effort while preserving the accuracy required for industrial AMRs. The collected warehouse dataset is made publicly available.
tldr: Presents an end-to-end UWB localization pipeline for industrial ground robots with automatic anchor calibration and terrain-aware sensor fusion, reducing manual effort while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于工业地面机器人的端到端UWB定位管线，具备自动锚点标定和地形感知传感器融合，在减少人工工作量的同时保持定位精度。

title: Towards Artificial Nerves: Biomimetic Optical-Fiber Tactile Sensing for Robots
summary: Robotic systems increasingly demand tactile sensing that approaches the adaptability and resolution of human skin to enable dexterous manipulation and safe interaction.
